sources.land: NASA NASADEM elevation and JRC Global Surface Water 1984-2021 at 90 m (research/acquire/landtype_proxy.py)
sources.patterns: BRRI cropping-pattern survey of every upazila, 2014-15 (Bangladesh Rice Journal 21(2), 2017)
sources.yields: BBS district crop tables 2022-23 to 2024-25 (Yearbook of Agricultural Statistics 2025)
sources.salinity: SRDI (2010) Saline Soils of Bangladesh, Appendix 2: soil salinity classes surveyed in May 2009
sources.saltTolerance: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 61 (2002), Annex 1 Table A1.1 (Maas and Grattan 1999)
sources.opera: NASA OPERA DSWx-S1 surface water from Copernicus Sentinel-1 radar, 2025 season: dry-season and monsoon-peak water share, and when 80% and 90% of the monsoon water had drained

barley.note: less tolerant as a seedling (ECe should not exceed 4-5 dS/m then)

boro.note: ECe of the soil water while submerged; less tolerant as a seedling; BRRI's salt-tolerant Boro (BRRI dhan47, 67, 97, 99) are not the engine's varieties

potato.note: BARI Potato-72 is listed as salt tolerant in crops/crop_parameters.csv

chickpea.note: threshold and slope assumed: the median of the table's moderately sensitive crops (maize and potato 1.7/12)

sesame.note: threshold and slope assumed: the median of the table's sensitive crops (mung bean 1.8/20.7 and bean 1.0/19)

lentil.note: not in FAO-61; taken as moderately sensitive

grasspea.note: not in FAO-61; taken as moderately sensitive

mustard.note: not in FAO-61 (canola, B. napus, is tolerant: 11.0/13); taken as moderately sensitive; BARI Mustard-11 and -19 are listed as salt tolerant in crops/crop_parameters.csv

jute.note: not in FAO-61; taken as moderately sensitive

landRule: low: water 3-6 months a year on >= 35% of the upazila (Landsat, 2021) or Boro-Fallow-Fallow on >= 50% of its cropped land (BRRI 2014-15); medium_low: >= 20% or >= 30%; high: lowest tenth of the land >= 20 m (NASADEM), almost no seasonal water, >= 90% never seen wet; else medium_high

lentil.valueSource: BBS 2024-25 harvest price (90.78 Tk/kg) x national yield
